title: Supported open counit tensor normalization
statement: For a finite commutative ring A, an open immersion k:U to Y, Q in D(Y_proet,A) and N in D(U_proet,A), put J=k_!N and T=P_kQ tensor N, using [def-pur-product-open-tensor-projection-data]. The tensor eta=(epsilon_Q tensor 1_J) is invertible; eta followed by rho equals delta=gamma_(P_kQ,J) followed by k_!(1 tensor openUnit_N inverse). Pulling eta back and following by the tensor-pullback/unit comparison rnu equals reta, where reta uses both inverse open units. Pulling rho back and following by openUnit_T inverse equals rnu. Both supported tensor objects are canonically isomorphic to k_!T, with no properness, boundedness or origin hypotheses.

source.place: Symmetry paragraph, proper reduction; explicit proof Steps 1--5 of lem-pur-product-open-tensor-projection.

proof.text: Apply open tensor normalization to k. Gamma and the open unit identify k_!P_kQ tensor J with k_!T. Symmetry, gamma at (N,Q), and extended symmetry identify Q tensor J with that same extension. The normalized restriction equations and the adjunction triangle give the displayed restrictions of eta and rho; the two Koszul symmetries cancel. The two maps to k_!T therefore have the same restriction. Full faithfulness gives their equality. Both normalized maps are invertible; their quotient eta is invertible.

lean.statement: theorem productOpenCounitNormalization (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {U Y : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion k] (Q : FiniteD A Y) (N : FiniteD A U) : let J := (finiteShriek A k).obj N let T := tensor A U ((pull A k).obj Q) N let η := tensorMap A Y ((adj A k).counit.app Q) (𝟙 J) let δ := gamma A k ((pull A k).obj Q) J ≫ (finiteShriek A k).map (tensorMap A U (𝟙 _) (openUnit A k N).inv) let rν := tensorPullIso A k Q J ≪≫ tensorIsoMap A U (Iso.refl _) (openUnit A k N).symm let rη := tensorPullIso A k ((finiteShriek A k).obj ((pull A k).obj Q)) J ≪≫ tensorIsoMap A U (openUnit A k ((pull A k).obj Q)).symm (openUnit A k N).symm IsIso η ∧ η ≫ rho A k Q N = δ ∧ (pull A k).map η ≫ rν.hom = rη.hom ∧ (pull A k).map (rho A k Q N) ≫ (openUnit A k T).inv = rν.hom ∧ Nonempty (tensor A Y ((finiteShriek A k).obj ((pull A k).obj Q)) J ≅ (finiteShriek A k).obj T) ∧ Nonempty (tensor A Y Q J ≅ (finiteShriek A k).obj T)
